task: Native PufferLib PongCNN; three actions; CHW 1x36x44; score bars
metric: Episode-averaged fraction of points won (not match win rate)

analysis.primary: Ours versus Nature within each shared recipe at 0.95 evaluated episode-averaged point fraction
analysis.bootstrap_unit: Whole paired training-seed blocks, shared across all models, checkpoints and recipes
analysis.interval: Pointwise percentile 95%; not simultaneous or frontier-wide dominance
analysis.crossing: First observed qualifying checkpoint; report previous checkpoint time and later declines separately
analysis.censoring: Retain non-achievers and missing evaluations; no success-only crossing-time means
analysis.failure_bounds: For missing final point fraction, report [0,1] identification bounds, not imputed point estimates
analysis.frontier: All observed per-seed sets and complete-case paired mean curves separately by shared recipe; no interpolation
analysis.replication: Fixed five seeds; no powered superiority guarantee, adaptive additions, or tuning against these results

wandb: disabled: SDK unavailable in reporting venv; no dependency installation required
